senses.gloss: Vācaspati^1 (“the Lord of Speech”). § 639 (Rājadh.): XII, 52, 1871 (api).--§ 787 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 31, 2014.--§ 782b (Brāhmaṇagītā): XIV, 21, 636 (tate Vºr jajñe taṃ manas paryavekshate).--Do.^2 (do.) = Mahāpurusha (Mahāpurushastava).--Do.^3 (do.) = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Vācāviruddhāḥ (pl.), a class of gods. § 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 18, †1372.
Vācikā, adj. (“belonging to speech,” viz. one of Brahmán's births). § 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 348, 13490 (janma, the third birth of Brahmán); 349, III), 13565 (do., do.).
